item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json, py_compile\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nreq = {'declared':['b','a','a','skip'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','meta':{'z':1,'x':2}},'b':{'kind':'missing'},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'a':{'meta':{'x':2,'z':1},'kind':'file'},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}}\\npol = {'ignored':['skip']}\\nr0, p0 = copy.deepcopy(req), copy.deepcopy(pol)\\nassert evaluate(req,pol) == {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}\\nassert req == r0 and pol == p0\\nreq2 = {'declared':['b','a','skip'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'3'},'b':{'kind':'directory','entries':[]},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'}}}\\nassert evaluate(req2,pol) == {'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','b']}\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))\\nassert report == [evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\npy_compile.compile('work.py',doraise=True)\\nprint('ok')\"]}"}
